characters.name: Director Gray
characters.description: A man in his mid-40s to early 50s, short grey hair, a stern face lined with fatigue. Always in a wheelchair, wearing a dark suit and a light shirt, with a focused expression and an analytical gaze.

alternateLooks.label: Adrian Cross
alternateLooks.description: A man around 40, athletic build, short dark hair and a few days of stubble. Wearing functional field clothing or smart casual, standing upright with an intense gaze.

alternateLooks.label: Wraith
alternateLooks.description: A tall, powerfully built figure dressed entirely in black, in close-fitting tactical clothing. Wears an opaque mask covering the whole face, dark gloves and boots, no visible features, poised and ready to act.

characters.name: Evelyn Marlowe
characters.description: A woman in her early 30s, dark brown hair tied back, sharp features and light eyes. Wearing field gear, a tactical jacket and dark trousers, with a determined expression.

alternateLooks.label: Iris
alternateLooks.description: A woman whose face is partly hidden by shadow or pixelation, dark hair worn loose, in a long coat and unobtrusive clothing. Seen on a video call, only part of her face and her determined eyes are visible.

characters.name: Mirror
characters.description: An abstract digital interface, rendered as glowing blue iconography, geometric lines and floating on-screen elements. It has no physical body and no human face.

characters.name: June Sato
characters.description: A young woman around 30, East Asian features, short black hair, rectangular glasses. Wearing technical or lab clothing, a light jacket over a pale t-shirt.

characters.name: Elias Voss
characters.description: A man around 50, grey hair combed back, a trimmed beard, angular face. Wearing a dark suit and tie, with an authoritative bearing and a calculating gaze.

characters.name: Theo Kade
characters.description: A man around 30, fair skin, short messy blond hair, a square jaw. Wearing a dark tactical uniform over a black t-shirt, with a serious expression.

characters.name: Marcus Wynn
characters.description: A man around 35, dark skin, a strong build, very short hair and a neatly trimmed beard. Wearing tactical clothing and a bulletproof vest, standing firmly.

characters.name: Lena Hart
characters.description: A woman in her late 20s, fair skin, straight blonde hair to the shoulders, delicate features and light eyes. Wearing simple clothes, a pale sweater and a light jacket.

characters.name: Daniel Hart
characters.description: A man in his early 30s, fair skin, short brown hair, light stubble. Wearing an office shirt and trousers, with an ID badge hanging around his neck.

A final photograph is placed on the table, June's hand hovering above it, hesitating.
June looks at the computer screen, her face illuminated by the message she just received. The room is silent and tense.
Adrian, a serious-looking man, stands in a dimly lit control room, reacting with concern to the latest message. He looks towards a monitor off-screen.
A sleek, high-tech interface glows in a dark room. The faint silhouette of MIRROR (an AI or operator) is visible, their presence suggested by a reflection or shadow.
